Hi Kimberly,

We discovered this morning that our sandbox for the evaluation has expired (looks like it hit the token cap on the 21st). We were mid-run on an internal benchmark and lost access. Can you confirm whether Bluehaven can get a short extension or a partial reactivation while we finalize procurement? Our procurement lead is out until Monday, so we need something that lets our engineers finish the last couple of runs this week.

A few data points that might help:
- Trial started: 2026-09-24
- Peak batch: 8 concurrent workers, avg seq len 512
- We used ~42k experimental tokens last week

If you can propose a quick path (credits, short top-up, or temporary developer-only access) that would be great. If there are forms/POs needed, please call that out — procurement is strict.

Thanks,
John

Hi John —

Thanks for the note and sorry for the interruption. We can absolutely accommodate a short-term plan so your engineers can complete the benchmark runs this week. Two options I recommend (summary below, full details attached):

Option A — Short grace top-up (fastest):
- One-time 35k token top-up to the existing sandbox (developer access only)
- Valid for 10 days from activation
- No contractual change; we’ll record as a one-off promotional allowance

Option B — Staged reactivation + procurement path (recommended if you want a smoother handoff):
- Reactivate full sandbox for 30 days with a 50k token allowance
- Requires a signed minimal MA (attached) or a PO referencing deal DH-5921
- We can enable billing hold until PO is received from Procurement

I attached a short usage report (bluehaven-usage-report-20261021.csv) so you can see the hit pattern and a one-page MA/proposal (bluehaven-ma-proposal-okt22.pdf) with the staged reactivation details.

If Procurement is slow this week, I can approve Option A from my side immediately — it’s the quickest path. If you prefer Option B and can loop Procurement, we’ll prepare a DocuSign to get this live the same day we receive the signed MA/PO.

Which path would you like to take? If you want Option A, I’ll push 35k now and confirm the sandbox is reachable. If Option B, please share the procurement contact and I’ll route the MA.

—Kimberly
